sources.source_audit: The printed program labels mass as Gt but multiplies by fitted wt.% CH/CFE without dividing 100; no subsequent scaling appears before output. The carbonaceous density statement Ro=0.577*(R*3.017) also conflicts with the tabulated 0.577–3.595 g/cm³ interval. These are apparent defects of printed code, not a demonstrated reconstruction of the execution producing Table 4. Published quantiles are retained as a historical report only and never calibrate this kernel. The report itself warns of omitted/modelled-wrong uncertainties potentially exceeding 100x, nonrepresentative missing-body H and grossly simplified taxonomy.
